problems.quote: if (context instanceof EntityCollisionContext ctx && ctx.getEntity() instanceof FreeCamera) {
problems.issue: Presented as a quote from Freecam's BlockStateBaseMixin, but the real handler has one more guard between the FreeCamera test and the isIgnored test. Disassembly of net/xolt/freecam/mixins/BlockStateBaseMixin.onGetCollisionShape (freecam-neoforge-1.3.0+mc1.21.jar, offsets 24-42) reads ModConfig.INSTANCE.collision.alwaysCheck and returns early when alwaysCheck is set and Freecam.isEnabled() is false; only then does it call CollisionBehavior.isIgnored(this.getBlock()) and cir.setReturnValue(Shapes.empty()). The quoted block shows no elision, so it reads as verbatim. Everything else about the hook is correct: the @Inject targets exactly getCollisionShape(BlockGetter, BlockPos, CollisionContext) at HEAD on BlockBehaviour$BlockStateBase (verified in the annotation).
problems.correction: Either add an elision marker for the alwaysCheck/Freecam.isEnabled() early return, or quote it: `if (ModConfig.INSTANCE.collision.alwaysCheck && !Freecam.isEnabled()) return;` before the isIgnored test.

problems.quote: whose signature carries two Sable-internal types, and this repository compiles against Sable 1.2.2
problems.issue: Three of the seven parameters are Sable types, not two: private static VoxelShape getSubLevelEntityCollisionShape(Entity, org.joml.Vector3dc, dev.ryanhcode.sable.companion.math.Pose3dc, BlockState, dev.ryanhcode.sable.util.LevelAccelerator, BlockPos, dev.ryanhcode.sable.api.math.LevelReusedVectors) — identical in libs/sable-neoforge-1.21.1-1.2.2.jar and in the 2.0.5 jar the pack runs (javap -p dev/ryanhcode/sable/sublevel/entity_collision/SubLevelEntityCollision). Reading only `util.LevelAccelerator` + `companion.math.Pose3dc` as "internal" and `api.math.LevelReusedVectors` as public API gets you to two, but that is not what the sentence says. Worth noting for the same paragraph: the signature is byte-for-byte identical between 1.2.2 and 2.0.5, so the "a signature that has moved" risk has not in fact materialised — the argument for the noPhysics route stands on the private-method/compile-version risk, not on an observed break.
problems.correction: "whose signature carries three Sable types (`Pose3dc`, `LevelAccelerator`, `LevelReusedVectors`)" — optionally adding that the signature happens to be unchanged between 1.2.2 and 2.0.5, so the risk is a future one.
